messages:
sara_cs: heads-up — ACME onboarding ticket #7892. They say GCP accelerator credits (promo code from partner) were confirmed on 2026-02-28 but nothing shows in their billing dashboard. customer provided marketplace order id: ORD-GCP-5542. asking for quick verification before escalating to partner.
julia_billing: thx sara. can you paste the marketplace order receipt and their GCP billingAccountId? need to cross-check our ledger vs marketplace sync logs.
sara_cs: receipt: https://gcp.marketplace/reports/ORD-GCP-5542 (customer redacted). billingAccountId: 0123-4567-89AB. customer also says status in marketplace UI is "Completed" and promo code "GCP-ACCL-2026" was applied.
kevin_ops: pinging billing sync jobs — i see a failed reconcile for that order around 2026-03-01 03:42 UTC. log snippet:
```
2026-03-01T03:42:15Z INFO billing.sync order=ORD-GCP-5542 start
2026-03-01T03:42:16Z ERROR billing.sync order=ORD-GCP-5542 code=409 reason=tenant_mismatch message="order tenant does not match customer tenant"
2026-03-01T03:42:16Z WARN billing.requeue order=ORD-GCP-5542 attempts=1
```
kevin_ops: looks like marketplace order tenant (partner acct) != customer tenant in our index, which made the automated grant abort. i opened a quick investigation: the marketplace sent the credit to partner-owned tenant instead of the customer's billing tenant. billing-bot also retried and failed once.
billing-bot: [automated] billing.sync_retry job=marketplace_reconcile job_id=mkp-7789 status=failed attempts=2 last_error="tenant_mismatch"
julia_billing: ok — two paths: 1) ask partner to reissue the grant to the correct tenant (slower), or 2) manual grant from our internal ledger to map ORD-GCP-5542 -> customer billingAccountId 0123-4567-89AB, then mark order reconciled. do we have approval to do manual grant for onboarding customers? @robin_oncall?
robin_oncall: manual grant ok for verified accelerator credits if partner confirms order id and evidence. i can sign off. pls record audit note and job id.
kevin_ops: performing manual ledger grant now. running internal command:
```
# internal ledger CLI (audit note required)
redwood-ledger credit apply --order ORD-GCP-5542 --amount 10000 --currency USD --billing-account 0123-4567-89AB --reason "GCP Accelerator promo - manual reconcile" --auditor robin_oncall
```
kevin_ops: command returned:
```
OK grant_id=GRANT-20260301-442 status=applied
```
sara_cs: sent update to customer: "we applied the accelerator credits on our side while we sort the marketplace routing with the partner. You should see balance changes within 1 minute in your Redwood console and GCP will reflect usage reductions on next invoice." asked them to confirm receipt.
customer_reply (via ticket): "I see the credit in the Redwood Console balance now, thanks! GCP billing line item hasn't updated yet but that's expected per your note. Please keep us posted on partner fix."
julia_billing: added audit entry: "manual grant GRANT-20260301-442 applied for ORD-GCP-5542 to billingAccount 0123-4567-89AB due to marketplace tenant_mismatch. Notified partner to reissue. contact: partner-support@vendor.com".
kevin_ops: flagged marketplace_reconcile job for improvements: capture tenant id in order payload, and if tenant_mismatch detected, create a pending_task instead of hard-failing so CS can triage faster.
robin_oncall: marking this as resolved for now. cc @sara_cs close ticket when customer confirms final invoice reconciliation with GCP. :white_check_mark:
sara_cs: will close on customer confirmation. thanks team :heart:
